title: Senior Engineering Manager (Bangkok based, relocation provided)
description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Get to Know our Team

In Agoda’s Engineering department, we build the scalable and fault‑tolerant systems. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: website, mobile apps, affiliate apis, inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, finance and more. These mission‑critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we must employ state‑of‑the‑art CI/CD, experimentation and advanced testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime. We also ensure that our systems are self‑healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state‑of‑the‑art languages like React, Redux state management, Javascript, Kotlin, Scala, data technologies like Kafka, Aerospike and Big Data, and agile development practices. Most importantly though, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or innovating on the latest fintech idea or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of our Engineering team.

The Opportunity

The Senior Engineering Manager role at Agoda is one of the most significant and challenging roles in Technology. The right candidate has both deep technical knowledge and exhibits extremely strong leadership and people development skills. They should also have experience leading large engineering teams and managing managers.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Manage large engineering teams
  • Directly manage engineering managers and star engineers.
  • Provide technical input into new business ideas
  • Work with senior leadership up to C‑level
  • Work and drive initiatives outside of your core team
  • Build and guide the technical roadmap for your area
  • Take ownership of major projects that are strategic to Agoda.
  • It’s important to have a love of engineering and a passion for building things elegantly and at scale. Staying in touch with where the industry is going is crucial, and it’s important to have strong opinions about how systems should be architected, engineered, and maintained.
  • Developing people – Despite our investment and belief in technology, people are still our greatest asset. The right candidate will have a keen interest in developing people: inspiring those around them so they can achieve their potential. Being able to bring A‑players such as yourself from outside and integrating them into the business will also be important.

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Experience managing large engineering teams (>25 people)
  • Experience hiring and managing engineering managers
  • Experience developing future engineering managers from within the company
  • Experience rapidly growing a team
  • Experience communicating to C‑level
  • At least 5 years of experience managing engineering teams, 10+ years of experience in software engineering.
  • Demonstrable experience as a system owner with operational responsibility
  • Able to operate with autonomously: making decisions, setting KPIs, with a strong sense of ownership
  • Extremely proficient in at least one programming language (React, Javascript, Kotlin, Scala, Java, C#)
  • Knowledge in scale, microservices and clean architecture.
  • A focus on velocity and quality, along with the right engineering metrics to guide and improve these.
  • Excellent people management and communication skills.
  • Minimum a B.S. in Computer Science or quantitative field;

It’s great if you have many of these:

  • Proficiency in range of backend programming languages.
  • Experience in data engineering
  • Have experience managing in a data driven company with experience analyzing and working with Big Data
  • A key player at an Internet company that is at scale with large numbers of users and transactions per second
  • Worked on global projects serving world markets with distributed data centers.
  • Experience in Fintech / Financial Systems

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly overseeing the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Overview

The Project Engineer Integrity will support offshore projects and life-extension activities by providing practical marine and structural engineering input. The role focuses on project execution, offshore readiness, integrity assessments, inspections, repairs, and MOC support, ensuring safe and compliant implementation of structural and marine modifications.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in concept selection, FEED, detailed design and execution of offshore brownfield and life-extension projects.
  • Provide marine and structural engineering input for FPSOs and other offshore structures.
  • Translate engineering deliverables into offshore execution scopes, including workpacks, methodologies, inspection strategies, and lifting/installation philosophies.
  • Interface with class societies, marine warranty surveyors, and inspection vendors on structural and marine matters.
  • Review, approve or coordinate structural analysis reports, integrity assessments, repair plans, reinforcement strategies and life-extension studies.
  • Support offshore campaigns involving inspections, repairs, modifications, installations or remediation works.
  • Work closely with marine, construction, operations, and HSE teams to ensure offshore readiness and safe execution.
  • Provide engineering support for structural integrity, reassessment, and life-extension of offshore assets.
  • Support Management of Change (MOC) processes related to structural and marine modifications.
  • Review inspection findings and define required repair, reinforcement or mitigation actions.
  • Support troubleshooting during offshore anomalies, impacts, or structural damage events.
  • Capture lessons learned from offshore activities and incorporate them into project practices and design standards.

Education

  • BSc or MSc in Civil, Structural, Offshore, or Marine Engineering.
  • Advanced degrees in Offshore Structures or Systems are considered a strong advantage.
  • Extensive relevant experience may compensate for formal education.

Experience

  • Minimum 6 years’ experience in oil & gas, ideally with offshore brownfield or FPSO background.
  • Proven experience with FPSOs, semisubmersibles or topside structures.
  • Experience in structural integrity and reassessment.
  • Experience in life-extension and RBI activities.
  • Experience in offshore inspections and repair campaigns.
  • Experience working with class societies and offshore regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong exposure to project execution and offshore operations, not only design.

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of Offshore steel structures
  • Structural integrity, fatigue, buckling, and yielding
  • Marine and structural interfaces
  • Familiarity with international standards and practices (e.g. ABS, API, ISO, DNV).
  • Experience with structural analysis and FEM tools (e.g. FEMAP/NX, ANSYS, ABAQUS).
  • Solid understanding of offshore inspection methodologies and repair techniques (including composite repairs).

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Network Manager (NWM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The NWM will work closely with the FIFA Technology teams and the Stadia Teams, as well as other stakeholders. The NWM will understand the stadia legacy network ensuring it will support FIFA’s needs during the FWWC 2027. The NWM will also manage the integration between FIFA’s Game’s Time network and the legacy network.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of network infrastructure for FIFA and Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) offices, FIFA Special Events, and the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Review and validate Network Infrastructure designs, ensuring all deliverables—hardware, passive infrastructure, cybersecurity, monitoring, alerting, etc.—are implemented according to FIFA standards across venues and offices.
  • Actively participate in scope definition, procurement processes, supplier selection, and onboarding of Telco and Network service providers.
  • Lead the deployment and implementation of network infrastructure, securing timely availability of components and services, including the commissioning and decommissioning of event venues.
  • Oversee the effective and efficient delivery of Network services for FIFA offices, tournaments, and selected FIFA events. Monitor progress, report status, identify risks, and ensure alignment with IT governance.
  • Perform equipment configuration, testing, handover, monitoring, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Support network-related projects by clarifying requirements, following robust change management procedures, and ensuring clear communication across stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and coaching to team members, including preparing best-practice materials and training resources
  • Create and/or manage KPIs dashboards for operating stadia networks (FIFA’s and legacy) for the Telecom Command Center (TCC)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred
  • Proven experience of successful delivery of complex network infrastructure projects

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong technical expertise in telecom service provider networks, wired/wireless infrastructure design and deployment, network integration, and connectivity.
  • Proven experience with WAN/LAN, MPLS, VPN, routing and switching technologies, and multicast operations.
  • Relevant technical certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, CISSP) or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid understanding of structured cabling (copper and fiber) in heterogeneous environments.
  • Excellent consulting, negotiation, communication, and facilitation skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to train and present to diverse audiences.
  • Team‑oriented mindset with the ability to work under tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrates patience, persistence, and a positive attitude.
  • Experience delivering wireless networks in complex, high‑density environments.
  • Grafana, PowerBI and other BI related tools for creating dashboards or collecting data.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portugues
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

Various

    • AI Governance & Ethics: Establish a secure framework for using AI tools within the company, ensuring strict adherence to data privacy, IP protection, and security compliance standards.
  • Technical Architecture & Innovation:
    • Architectural Oversight: Design and oversee the roadmap for complex, scalable platforms, ensuring they are built for resilience and future growth.
    • Tech Stack Modernization: Continuously evaluate and optimize our infrastructure and cloud strategy to support high-performance AI integration.
    • Mentorship: Provide high-level technical guidance to Principal Engineers and Architects, resolving complex blockers and fostering technical excellence.
  • Organizational Leadership & Scaling:
    • Team Building: Build and structure high-performing engineering teams from the ground up, optimizing for agility and cross‑functional collaboration.
    • Process Optimization: Implement "AI-native" workflows that redefine how we hire, onboard, and manage engineering talent for maximum output.
    • Culture of Innovation: Foster an environment where experimentation is encouraged, but accountability and delivery are paramount.
  • Commercial & Client Strategy:
    • Serve as the primary technical voice in high‑stakes client meetings, simplifying complex architectural concepts into compelling business value propositions.
    • Business Growth: Partner with Sales and Product teams to articulate the competitive advantage of our AI-enabled development processes to prospective clients and investors.
    • Client Solution Viability & Compliance: Ensure the flexibility and compliance of AI adoption strategies (governance, tools, data privacy) to meet the diverse security and regulatory requirements of our clients.

Must Have

  • Senior Leadership Experience: 5+ years in a senior technology role (VP of Engineering, CTO, or Deputy CTO) with a focus on software delivery.
  • AI Implementation Track Record: Demonstrable experience leading the transformation of engineering teams through Generative AI (e.g., LLMs for code generation, automated testing suites, and documentation).
  • Proven ROI Analysis: Expertise in quantifying the efficiency gains derived from technical initiatives and reporting these to executive stakeholders.
  • Governance Expertise: Strong understanding of security risks and governance associated with using third‑party AI tools in an enterprise environment.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business strategy for non‑technical audiences.
  • Modern Tech Stack Expertise: Hands‑on experience working with several modern technologies such as .NET, Python, React/React Native, Angular, Next.js, TypeScript, among others. This includes the ability to guide teams across diverse frameworks, evaluate technological trade‑offs, and define best practices across frontend, backend, and full‑stack development.

title: AZZAS F&L | Especialista de AI | Labs
description:
Job description

Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

Estamos construindo o time de AI que vai transformar a forma como a empresa resolve problemas reais, toma decisões e opera no dia a dia. Nosso objetivo é levar a inteligência artificial para além de experimentos, tornando seu uso prático, responsável e parte natural da rotina das áreas. Aqui, AI é ferramenta de impacto: usada com senso crítico, foco em valor e liberdade para experimentar, aprender e evoluir continuamente.

Se você gosta de construir soluções, explorar novas possibilidades e aplicar AI de forma concreta, esse é o lugar.

QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?

Main responsibilities

Você será o pilar técnico e cultural de AI da empresa , responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a stack de AI, acelerando os times de projeto e garantindo que a adoção de AI aconteça com qualidade técnica, segurança e impacto real no negócio — sem burocracia excessiva.

Esse papel é hands-on por natureza , com forte viés de arquitetura e evangelização, atuando como referência técnica e catalisador da maturidade de AI na companhia.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de AI da empresa.
  • Estabelecer diretrizes de governança técnica , avaliando riscos em soluções de AI.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para analistas e times de tecnologia, apoiando decisões arquiteturais e desbloqueando problemas complexos.
  • Acompanhar ativamente a evolução do ecossistema de AI (GenAI, agentes, plataformas, frameworks) e desafiar continuamente a stack atual .
  • Atuar em casos estratégicos ou de maior risco , seja de forma direta ou consultiva.
  • Promover upskilling técnico e cultural , ajudando a tornar AI parte da rotina de diferentes áreas, não apenas da tecnologia.
  • Traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos de AI em implicações práticas de negócio, risco e escalabilidade.

Requirements and skills

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS:

  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de software e/ou engenharia de dados .
  • Capacidade de desenhar e implementar soluções de AI end-to-end , usando código, plataformas e ferramentas de forma pragmática.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de dados e AI (cloud, pipelines, APIs, automações, agentes).
  • Forte domínio de pensamento arquitetural , trade-offs técnicos e avaliação de riscos.
  • Facilidade em usar modelos de AI para acelerar desenvolvimento em múltiplas linguagens .
  • Aplicação prática de soluções de AI a problemas reais.

REQUISITOS COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  • Perfil naturalmente curioso e engajado com novas soluções de AI.
  • Comunicação clara e didática com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade de influenciar sem autoridade formal.
  • Pragmatismo: buscar a melhor solução possível .
  • Postura de parceiro.

Additional information

NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:

Além de trabalhar no maior grupo de moda do Brasil, focado em impulsionar talentos e especializado em fazer gigante, por aqui você também ganha:

Vale Refeição ou Refeitório;

Vale Transporte;

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (apólice coletiva opcional);

Gympass;

Day-off no seu aniversário para você curtir muito;

Formato híbrido, para você trabalhar de onde quiser;

Até 50% de desconto nas nossas marcas;

Código de Vendedor, com direito a comissão sobre vendas nos sites;

PLR, de acordo com a nossa política;

Vagas de estacionamento e van no fim do dia, para te levar até o metrô mais próximo;

Cursos, palestras e Trilhas de Desenvolvimento, ao vivo e na nossa plataforma de conteúdo;

Avaliação de desempenho;

Muita visibilidade e exposição positiva, pra você conseguir se conectar com todo mundo sem muita hierarquia.

title: Banco de Talentos (Gerente de Loja)
description:
A Nalin tem como compromisso encantar nossos clientes e proporcionar uma experiência única. Com atuação no varejo de moda do estado do Rio de Janeiro, oferecemos produtos de qualidade e preços acessíveis, sempre com foco no atendimento de excelência.

Se você é apaixonado pelo varejo, gosta de encantar os clientes e deseja fazer parte de uma empresa que busca a excelência, junte-se a nós! Estamos em constante evolução e buscamos novos talentos para fazer parte dessa história de sucesso.

Venha crescer conosco e contribuir para a experiência única que proporcionamos aos nossos clientes!

Se você se identificou com a nossa empresa, VENHA FAZER DO NOSSO TIME !

  • Gestão e controle de todas as operações de Vendas e Produtos Financeiros da Loja;
  • Análise de indicadores e KPI’s da Loja;
  • Orientar e acompanhar os serviços de vendas conforme a política estabelecida para assegurar o eficiente atendimento aos clientes;
  • Acompanhar as atividades de loja na apresentação das mercadorias e procedimento de controle de estoque;
  • Participação dos processos de seleção, admissão, jornada, férias, rescisão e afins do time de loja;
  • Estratégia de mercado e concorrência;
  • Inventário de estoque, bem como acompanhamento de relatórios (recebimento de mercadorias, entrada e saída de notas fiscais);
  • Gerenciamento dos contratos de manutenção e negociação de espaços na loja;
  • Cumprimento das exigências fiscais, sanitárias, etc. dos órgãos públicos.
  • Escolaridade necessária: Ensino Superior Completo - Obrigatório;
  • Desejável vivência anterior em Varejo de Moda;
  • Conhecimento em KPIs de vendas;
  • Desejável vivência com liderança de pessoas;

Nossa trajetória

Nossa trajetória é marcada pela dedicação, compromisso com a qualidade e foco constante em proporcionar uma experiência única para nossos clientes e para nosso time. Estamos no mercado desde 1971, alcançando resultados de excelência e com o objetivo de atender às necessidades de diversas famílias. Ao longo dessa jornada, nos estabelecemos como uma referência no mercado, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de produtos com qualidade e preços acessíveis.

Ao longo dos anos, crescemos e nos expandimos, conquistando a confiança e a lealdade de nossos consumidores. Hoje, com mais de 40 lojas espalhadas pelo Rio de Janeiro e uma equipe de colaboradores comprometidos, tornamo-nos sinônimo de excelência no atendimento e a um ambiente acolhedor.

Nosso história também é marcada pela valorização de nosso time, com programas de reconhecimento e ações de integração que fortalecem o espírito de equipe e a cultura organizacional. Acreditamos que nosso sucesso é reflexo do trabalho árduo e do empenho de cada membro da equipe, que, juntos, compartilham os mesmos valores de comprometimento, igualdade e melhoria contínua.

Hoje, seguimos nos reinventando e nos adaptando às necessidades do mercado. Nossa missão permanece firme, guiando todos os passos da empresa rumo a novos desafios e conquistas.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from 'Bronze' (Raw) to 'Silver' (Cleaned) and 'Gold' (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don\u2019t just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

title: Brazil - Remote: Team Lead - Digital Twin Platform
description:
Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real‑time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi‑agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: Drive cross‑boundary architectural decisions. Decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. Review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On‑Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high‑level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade‑offs across the entire stack:

  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time‑Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands‑on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies.
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy‑focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect‑Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full‑Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

  • Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigando riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores;
  • Inspecionar locais, instalações e equipamentos da empresa e determinar fatores de riscos de acidentes;
  • Realizar auditorias internas e treinamentos de Segurança do Trabalho em todos os Setores da unidade Hospitalar, de forma rotineira, identificando condições insalubres e perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como orientar e conscientizar os colaboradores quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho;
  • Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);
  • Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;
  • Acompanhar de forma permanente as atividades realizadas pela CIPA, estudando suas observações e propostas, visando a adoção das soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho e meio ambiente dela valendo-se como agente multiplicador;
  • Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI);
  • Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros;
  • Fazer inspeção em equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, recursos audiovisuais e didáticos e outros materiais considerados indispensáveis, de acordo com a legislação vigente;
  • Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes;
  • Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;
  • Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios;
  • Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis;
  • Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;
  • Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes;

Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque. Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas. Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores. Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores. Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente. Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos da mesma, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista. Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente; Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas. Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção. Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas. Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio. Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total dos mesmos, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa. Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de oferecer informações e gerar uma integração. Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores. Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA. Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências. Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações. Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que a mesma seja emitida. Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho. Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente. Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente. Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS. Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações. description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package. Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted.

English proficiency (written and spoken) required

Overview

We are seeking an AI Governance Officer to join our Corporate Data Office Division (CDOD) within our Cybersecurity Organization. CDOD focuses on AI governance, including the design and implementation of robust AI governance frameworks that ensure the ethical, transparent, and compliant use of AI and machine learning technologies. Your primary role is to play a key role in shaping and driving AI governance across the organization. You will join the AI governance team to implement policies, General Instructions (GIs), frameworks, and lifecycle controls that ensure the appropriate use and implementation of AI systems. In this role, you will help govern AI deployments activities to ensure alignment with the company’s standards and strategic objectives, collaborate with stakeholders to ensure compliance with regulations and foster a culture of accountability and transparency in all AI‑related initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement AI governance framework for responsible AI development ensuring alignment with global regulatory standards.
  • Develop and implement governance guidelines for AI development and deployment.
  • Conduct review of AI solutions, in terms of adherence to ethical and responsible AI principles and controls. This independent review shall not be performed by those who develop, train, test and/or deploy AI models.
  • Conduct reviews to identify potential risks and impact suggest remedies before an AI project goes live.
  • Conduct periodical reviews on the AI governance process and documentation.
  • Conduct technical assessment which covers the AI development and deployment process as well as the third‑party AI product procurement process.
  • Ensure AI risks are identified and managed appropriately through the organization's risk governance process.
  • Support the AI governance process over the AI inventory, issue tracking, governance meetings & management reporting.
  • Perform risk analysis whenever an application or system undergoes a major change.
  • Oversee and conduct periodic assessments and evaluations to validate adherence to governance standards and regulatory obligations.
  • Develop methods to effectively monitor and measure risk, compliance and assurance efforts.
  • Devise strategies and protocols to minimize risks associated with AI, including developing robust testing methods and risk management frameworks.
  • Stay updated with regulations and standards and ensure that AI systems comply with these guidelines.
  • Develop and deliver awareness programs to educate stakeholders on AI governance principles, policies, and compliance requirements.

Qualifications

  • You must hold a Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. A master's degree in Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
  • You should have a minimum of 15 years’ experience in application development, system administration, and data management, including 10 years of experience of implementing AI, computer vision, NLP, and LLM solutions.
  • 5 years of experience designing and implementing AI governance and risk management programs is also required.
  • You must also be able to demonstrate a strong knowledge in responsible AI and AI evaluations, bias detection, data centric, Agentic AI, AIOps, data privacy by design, LLM red teaming, methodologies for explaining ability and interpretability and cloud computing environments.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

description:

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a "deliver fast" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers
  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.

  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

description:
Overview

Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho deve garantir a integridade física e a saúde dos colaboradores próprios e terceiros, a conformidade legal e a prevenção de acidentes nas operações de transportes e logística da DeLuna, promovendo uma cultura de segurança alinhada aos valores e metas ESG da empresa.

Requisitos

  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho concluído. Registro/credenciamento profissional.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em operações de logística, armazenagem e transportes.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos:
  • NRs aplicáveis (NR-01, 04, 05, 06, 07, 10, 11, 12, 17, 20, 23, 26, 33, 35).
  • PGR, inventário de riscos, APR, permissões de trabalho, investigação de acidentes.
  • Segurança em armazéns, docas, empilhadeiras, amarração e movimentação de cargas.
  • Noções de saúde ocupacional e eSocial.
  • Combate a incêndio e brigada; plano de emergência e simulados.
  • Ergonomia aplicada a logística e operações frigorificadas.
  • Ferramentas:
  • Pacote Office/Google e ferramentas de checklists/auditorias digitais.
  • Sistemas de gestão de SST/SESMT e eSocial.
  • Habilitações/cursos desejáveis:
  • Instrutor NR-35/NR-33, brigada de incêndio, direção defensiva.
  • Noções de ISO 45001 e ISO 14001; primeiros socorros.
  • CNH B; disponibilidade para viagens.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Foco em segurança e cuidado ativo; presença em campo.
  • Comunicação clara e didática com públicos diversos.
  • Influência e negociação para gerenciamento de mudanças.
  • Organização, senso de urgência e disciplina na gestão de planos de ação.
  • Colaboração e postura consultiva com atendimento personalizado, alinhada aos valores DeLuna.
  • Integridade, confidencialidade e respeito às pessoas.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em operações e-commerce/last mile.
  • Experiência com gestão de transportadores terceiros e auditorias de clientes.
  • Participação em projetos de certificação e programas de cultura de segurança.

Responsabilidades e Atividades

  • Governança SST e Compliance
  • Atuar como integrante do SESMT conforme dimensionamento da NR-04.
  • Implementar e manter o PGR com inventário de riscos e plano de ação; apoiar as avaliações de exposição conforme NRs vigentes.
  • Apoiar a CIPA no dimensionamento, capacitação e cronograma anual; organizar SIPAT.
  • Gerir EPI/EPC: especificação, distribuição, rastreabilidade, controle de vida útil e treinamentos.
  • Assegurar conformidade com NRs aplicáveis às operações DeLuna.
  • Acompanhar legislação aplicável ao transporte e logística e requisitos de clientes.
  • Operações de CDs, XPTs e Transit Points
  • Realizar inspeções de rotina e emitir relatórios com planos de ação.
  • Validar layout seguro, sinalização, rotas de pedestres/empilhadeiras, proteção de estruturas, housekeeping.
  • Conduzir análises ergonômicas pontuais e propor melhorias.
  • Inspecionar sistemas de combate a incêndio e suportar brigada de incêndio;
  • Verificar condições de câmaras frias e EPIs térmicos em operações frigorificadas.
  • Transporte Rodoviário (FM/MM/LM, LH)
  • Apoiar programas de direção defensiva, análise de rotas críticas, gestão de fadiga e pausas.
  • Realizar inspeções de frota focadas em segurança.
  • Verificar documentação e treinamentos obrigatórios de motoristas e ajudantes conforme a legislação aplicável.
  • Conduzir DDS e blitz de segurança em pátios e pontos de apoio.
  • Investigar sinistros rodoviários e quase-acidentes, propondo ações corretivas e lições aprendidas.
  • Saúde Ocupacional e eSocial
  • Interface com PCMSO e Médico do Trabalho: exames admissionais, periódicos, retorno ao trabalho e mudança de função.
  • Apoiar os eventos do eSocial em conjunto com RH/DP e colaboradores.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de laudos e avaliações por profissionais legalmente habilitados, providenciando dados e acompanhando planos de ação.
  • Treinamentos, Cultura e Comunicação
  • Planejar, ministrar e/ou coordenar treinamentos obrigatórios e específicos.
  • Gerenciar a matriz de capacitação, controles de validade e reciclagens; garantir 100% de aderência.
  • Conduzir campanhas e comunicações de segurança, reforçando os valores e a cultura DeLuna.
  • Emergências e Preparação/Resposta
  • Manter plano de emergência atualizado: cenários em armazéns, câmaras frias, incêndio, vazamento de combustíveis, sinistros rodoviários.
  • Realizar simulados periódicos com brigada e times operacionais; alinhar com corpo de bombeiros e contratadas.
  • Garantir kits de emergência, fichas de segurança e contatos úteis disponíveis e atualizados.
  • Gestão de Terceiros e Fornecedores
  • Qualificar, auditar e acompanhar prestadores sob critérios de SST; verificar documentos, treinamentos e indicadores.
  • Incluir requisitos de SST em contratos e SLAs em parceria com Suprimentos e Jurídico.
  • Acompanhar execução de manutenção predial e de equipamentos por terceiros com Permissão de Trabalho quando aplicável.
  • ESG e Melhoria Contínua
  • Contribuir para metas ESG.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas/externas e requisitos de clientes;
  • Liderar investigação de incidentes com metodologia estruturada e garantir a eficácia das ações.

About the project:

As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer , you will own and optimize OpenTelemetry pipelines, enabling scalable and efficient observability. You’ll build tools that empower teams, support incident response, and drive best practices. Your work ensures a reliable, secure infrastructure and actionable alerting across the organization.

How your day-to-day work will look like

Design, implement, and maintain observability pipelines across the three main signals—logs, metrics, and traces—ensuring standardized, scalable, and efficient data ingestion. Optimize ingestion strategies to balance cost, performance, and usability.

Build self-service automation and tooling that enables development teams to instrument and leverage observability without requiring manual intervention from the SRE team. Drive adoption of best practices while ensuring teams own their telemetry.

Design the processes, playbooks, checklists, and automations for them and other engineers to follow during an incident.

Interact with members from almost all teams across the business to understand their monitoring, alerting, and SLO / SLA requirements and design systems and processes that ensure we meet or exceed these requirements. Influence architectural decisions during initial design stages to ensure resiliency and scale at the outset of software development.

Design the processes, playbooks, checklists, and automations for them and other engineers to follow during an incident.

Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to provision and manage monitoring tools, alerting rules, and our observability configurations across OTEL Pipelines.

Design base-level requirements for new and existing services to ensure that all client infrastructure and code are monitored consistently and accurately at a basic level.

Take full ownership of client infrastructure reliability, ensuring adherence to key availability and security KPIs.

This would make you the ideal candidate

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

8+ Years of experience working as an SRE Engineer or in a very similar role, more focused on observability.

5+ Years of experience working with cloud (AWS).

5+ Years of experience working with IaC tools (Terraform) and GitOps CI/CD solutions (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, or similar).

4+ Years of experience working with monitoring and logging tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, New Relic, or Datadog (experience managing observability pipelines at scale in high-throughput environments).

4+ Years of experience working in Kubernetes, including its core components, deployment methodologies, and monitoring best practices.

Strong communication skills with team members and stakeholders (technical and nontechnical communication).

Strong scripting abilities (Python, Go, or similar) for automating observability tasks.

Experience integrating incident management platforms (PagerDuty, Jira) with automated alerting workflows.

Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Overview

Join to apply for the Open Source Enterprise Sales / Alliances - Colombia (Spanish Speaker) role at Canonical . While this link is looking in particular for a Spanish Speaker to work on the Colombian territory, this is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales and Alliances teams. Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

About Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Roles

As we continue to grow we are looking to hire both Enterprise Sales and Alliances Sales representatives to drive revenue growth and meet our goals. Our Alliances Sales Directors own a book of business helping to enable Canonical to work with its go to market partners, hardware vendors, software vendors, solutions integrators and distributors and channels. With a fast growing channel business, GSI/SI and Hardware partners, we need to enable, manage and grow business opportunities and drive market expansion alongside revenue growth. Reporting to the Alliances leadership, you will be working with direct sales, marketing, product, customer success, finance, legal and support as you demonstrate thought leadership, practical skills, and apply your knowledge and experience to help us grow in this critical area. Our Enterprise Sales Executives own the relationships with our direct customers and are responsible for maintaining and growing relationships that result in mutually beneficial engagements. description:
Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Centro Especializado de Estímulo ao Desenvolvimento Infantil - Reabilitação Intelectual e TEA (CEEDI) é um serviço cuja proposta é rever e transformar a lógica do capacitismo e oportunizar o diagnóstico qualificado em tempo oportuno, por meio de um modelo de serviço que incorpore a avaliação especializada para o diagnóstico diferencial, estimulação precoce, com equipe multidisciplinar para processo de re/habilitação, envolvendo a rede de apoio no processo e projeto terapêutico.

Trata-se de um centro de reabilitação, modalidade reabilitação intelectual, com ações e serviços voltados para avaliar, desenvolver ou ampliar a capacidade funcional para o desenvolvimento pleno das crianças e adolescentes com deficiência intelectual, transtornos globais de desenvolvimento, transtorno do espectro autista, investindo em iniciativas que trabalhem potencialidades, talentos, habilidades e aptidões físicas, cognitivas, sensoriais, psicossociais, atitudinais, profissionais e artísticas, para a autonomia e participação cidadã em igualdade de condições e oportunidades com as demais pessoas. A habilitação/reabilitação prevê uma abordagem interdisciplinar e o envolvimento direto de profissionais, cuidadores e familiares/ parceiros nos processos de cuidado.

O profissional, terá a função de realizar o seguimento das crianças com alterações nos marcos do desenvolvimento, contemplando a avaliação longitudinal com o objetivo de elucidação diagnóstica, início precoce da estimulação precoce e orientação dos familiares e responsáveis.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina com registro ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Registro de especialista em Psiquiatria (RQE)
  • Desejável pós-graduação em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Saúde Mental; TEA; Saúde da Família; Saúde Pública; Saúde Coletiva
  • Registro ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Desejável experiência com TEA (Transtorno do Espectro Autista na infância e adolescência)

Additional information

  • Carga Horária: 40h/20h semanais
  • Local de atuação: AP 3.3 (Madureira e Adjacências)

Trabalhamos com foco em sermos reconhecidos como referência nacional na área portuária e marítima, promovendo uma logística integrada de forma eficaz e reafirmando a nossa vocação criativa, tornando-nos a maior operadora multiuso do Brasil. Ética, respeito e transparência definem nosso trabalho; prezamos pela segurança, pela união e pelo trabalho em equipe. A Triunfo busca gestão baseada em resultados, valorizando o desempenho, a iniciativa e a integridade de cada um. Inovação é fundamental para entregar resultados diferenciados ao mercado. Temos paixão pelo que fazemos e buscamos oferecer o melhor aos nossos clientes e colaboradores.

title: Recruiter BRA (Remote)
description:
A Recruiter is responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent to meet an organization’s staffing needs, ensuring that each hire aligns with both the technical requirements and the cultural values of the company. This role involves proactively sourcing candidates through a variety of channels, including job boards, professional networks, social media platforms, recruitment agencies, industry events, and employee referrals.

Once potential candidates are identified, the Recruiter screens applications, conducts initial assessments, and manages interview processes to evaluate skills, experience, and fit. They work closely with hiring managers to define job requirements, craft compelling job descriptions, and establish selection criteria that lead to strong matches.

The role extends beyond simply filling positions—it also involves managing the entire recruitment lifecycle from initial contact to offer negotiation and onboarding. This includes coordinating interviews, providing feedback to candidates, ensuring timely communication, and guiding both candidates and hiring teams through each stage of the process. A strong focus on candidate experience is key, as positive interactions contribute to the employer’s brand and long-term talent pipeline.

In many cases, Recruiters also track and analyze hiring metrics—such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and source effectiveness—to refine strategies and improve overall recruitment efficiency. They stay informed about labor market trends, competitive compensation data, and evolving recruitment technologies, adapting approaches to remain competitive in attracting top talent.

To excel, a Recruiter must combine exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with strategic thinking, organization, and relationship-building capabilities. Their work plays a critical role in shaping the company’s workforce, influencing its ability to grow, innovate, and succeed.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team . Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We are hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Há mais de 90 anos transformamos vidas através da engenharia. E agora, queremos você para fazer parte dessa história de sucesso!

Na Passarelli, somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos e acreditamos que a engenharia pode transformar vidas. Com mais de 90 anos de história, construímos um legado de inovação, ética e compromisso. Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho humanizado, onde cada profissional é parte essencial do nosso sucesso.

title: Venue Telecom Manager
description:
Venue Telecom Manager

Department: Technology

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Venue Telecom Manager (VTCM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The VTCM will work closely with the Technology teams in all the stadiums and IBCC and Zurich, as well as other stakeholders, to deliver critical Network and telecommunications solutions for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of telecommunications infrastructure and services across competition and non-competition venues, including:
  • Broadcast Contribution Network (BCN)
  • Event Network (WAN, MAN, LAN, WLAN, cabling, containment)
  • Internet, VLAN, VPN services, VoIP
  • Mobile Network and Private 5G
  • Push-to-Talk/Private Mobile Radios
  • Spectrum Management
  • CATV/IPTV
  • Rate Card services (Internet/IP Codecs)
  • Deploy and oversee technology services across various venues.
  • Stadia, training sites, operation centers, accreditation centers, ticketing centers, hotels, airports, and transport hubs.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA standards in the integration of tournament technology services, such as Accreditation and Ticketing, with the FIFA Event Network environment.
  • Collaborate with Football Technology Innovation suppliers, media, broadcasters, and other functional stakeholders to define and fulfill network and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Coordinate on-site IT and telecom technical teams for infrastructure testing, acceptance, and operations.
  • Manage incident resolution and ensure adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs), escalating risks and issues to the Technology Command Center (TCC).
  • Support spectrum management efforts, including interference resolution in collaboration with regulatory authorities and venue teams.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting, including daily updates to the TCC and post-event analysis.
  • Participate in pre-tournament training, readiness exercises, and rehearsals.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of IT/Technology experience, preferably in major events.
  • Strong knowledge of IT and telecommunications technologies, including CATV, AV systems, radio communications, VLANs and related areas.
  • Experience coordinating with diverse teams and managing vendor relationships.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred

Skills & Competencies

  • Manager with experience in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee.
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

Various

  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more)
